sections.strategy: No new strategic announcements this week; the story is still the 24 Sept FY26 pre-close update. GMV grew low-single-digits in Q4 after a multi-quarter decline (full year still -5%), adjusted gross margin came in above 50%, and net debt fell to about £110m after selling the Lichfield and Atlanta warehouses for roughly £116m. Full FY26 results are due 5 November.
sections.pricing: October promotions on asos.com are running at up to 25% off, including first-app-order codes. That is normal seasonal activity, and management is still prioritising gross margin (now above 50%) over discount-led volume.
sections.launches: The last product launch was the Adaptive occasionwear collection on 24 Sept, co-created with Disabled customers and Tilting the Lens across womenswear, menswear and Curve. Law Roach was named ASOS's first Stylist in Residence on 19 Sept. ASOS plc posted no new launches from 28 Sept to 5 Oct.
sections.gossip: Goldman Sachs filed a TR-1 holdings notification on 2 Oct, and the ASOMY ADR hit a 12-month high around 28 Sept after Shore Capital upgraded the stock to Buy and Berenberg raised its target to 750p. Correction to earlier briefings: ASOS sold 75% of Topshop/Topman to Bestseller in 2024 and now holds only 25%, so Topshop's John Lewis concessions and its return to physical retail are Bestseller-led.
soWhat: With gross margin above 50% and net debt falling, ASOS is unlikely to give up margin on intake. Expect firm cost-price pressure going into SS27 negotiations, and lead with value-engineering ideas rather than straight price cuts.

Returning to GMV growth in the UK, Germany and the US means modest volume upside for own-brand ASOS Design. Suppliers with speed-to-market capacity (UK, Turkey) are best placed for repeat orders on proven lines such as occasionwear and outerwear.

Topshop and Topman buying now sits mainly with Bestseller, not ASOS. Suppliers targeting those brands should go to Bestseller's sourcing teams, and should watch the 5 Nov FY26 results for any update to ASOS's factory list or Fashion with Integrity reporting.
